content: `vendor-scorecard` is a weekly vendor scorecard tool for procurement managers, not a general analytics platform.
The launch path starts with CSV import first.
Vendor reliability is computed from on-time delivery rate and return rate.
The first release is read-only and should not assume a manual editing UI.
Once the `vendor-scorecard` workspace exists, ongoing implementation should follow the repository brief and live workspace files.
Earlier chat should contribute stable baseline decisions into the workspace, but disposable brainstorm ideas should not become default project requirements.
